card.name: Verbs awaiting a speed word
card.fires_on: Verbs of spreading, moving or giving by injection or infusion, right before a speed word such as rapidly, slowly or at lightning speed. Also 'very' just before 'slowly'.

modes.label: Injection and infusion verbs
modes.description: Verbs like injected, infused or Injection in dosing directions, where a rate of delivery comes next.
modes.example: Phentolamine Mesylate for Injection, USP is<< injected>> rapidly.

modes.label: Growth or change verbs
modes.description: General web verbs like expanding or move where a pace word follows.
modes.example: Technological advancements<< move>> at lightning speed, with the average device

modes.label: Intensifier before a rate
modes.description: The word very placed before slowly in directions on how to inject.
modes.example: inject the drug<< very>> slowly, not exceeding 1 mg per

card.writes: It pushes the model to write speed words like fast, quickly and rapidly next, and away from travel and moving words.
card.plain: It fires on a verb or 'very' when the next word is likely to say how fast something happens or is given.
